# Comprehensive Research Report Quality Checklist

## Source and independence

- [ ] Exact source run, status and lineage are recorded.
- [ ] Evidence integrity was verified.
- [ ] Existing synthesis, canonical reports, appendices and independent reports were
      excluded before analysis.
- [ ] No provider, Persona, prototype or code analysis pipeline was invoked.
- [ ] Source artifacts remain unchanged.

## Complete coverage

- [ ] Every configured question and answer slot is accounted for.
- [ ] Every eligible answer and reason was reviewed.
- [ ] Substantive/reviewed counts reconcile.
- [ ] Invalid, missing, skipped, automation and `not_observed` rows remain explicit.
- [ ] Candidate exposure is verified.

## Method quality

- [ ] Structured choice and route counts are deterministic.
- [ ] Thematic counts use explicit reviewed memberships.
- [ ] Episode evidence verifies experience facts only.
- [ ] Prototype limitations are not product defects.
- [ ] Untried or persistent behavior is not inferred.

## Finding quality

- [ ] Findings are concrete, non-overlapping and decision-relevant.
- [ ] Different controls and different actions remain separate.
- [ ] Support, denominator, source questions and counterevidence are traceable.
- [ ] Losing-candidate strengths are preserved.
- [ ] Minority views appear only when they change interpretation or action.
- [ ] Findings are not repeated in every section.

## Segment quality

- [ ] Only configured or requested segments are used.
- [ ] Group sizes are shown.
- [ ] Small groups remain descriptive.
- [ ] Shared patterns and no-difference conclusions are retained.
- [ ] No attribute is treated as the cause of an opinion.
- [ ] Segment combinations do not expose reconstructed identities.

## Document usefulness

- [ ] Executive conclusion answers the study decision.
- [ ] The main findings precede route, segment and method inventories.
- [ ] The document is comprehensive without becoming an answer dump.
- [ ] Candidate sections add detail rather than repeat the executive summary.
- [ ] The Persona matrix is anonymized and decision-relevant.
- [ ] Next validation follows from uncertainty.

## Recommendations

- [ ] Every recommendation has an explicit target.
- [ ] Actions are concrete and supported.
- [ ] Product changes, enhancements and research follow-up are distinct.
- [ ] Priorities preserve validated strengths.
- [ ] Recommendations do not promise unverified product behavior.

## Limitations and privacy

- [ ] Synthetic status and non-representativeness are prominent.
- [ ] Order, path, prototype and system-level limits are accurate.
- [ ] Raw IDs and unnecessary profile fields are absent.
- [ ] Output is private unless publication was authorized.
- [ ] Filename is new and clearly non-canonical.
- [ ] Delivery confirms no Persona or configured provider was invoked.
